title: The Prince (upcoming film)

text.lead: The Prince is an upcoming American drama film directed by Cameron Van Hoy, written by David Mamet, and starring Scott Haze.
text.plot: According to The Guardian, the film "will refract aspects of Hunter Biden’s life through proxy Parker Scott".
text.cast:
- Scott Haze as Parker
- Nicolas Cage as The Pimp
- J. K. Simmons
- Giancarlo Esposito
- Andy García
- Simon Rex
- Wayne Brady
- George Newbern
- Beverly D'Angelo
- Inanna Sarkis
- Paul Cassell
- Courtnee Carter
text.production:
In June 2024, it was announced that Haze, Cage, Simmons, Esposito and Garcia were cast in the film. In July that same year, it was announced that Rex, Sarkis, Brady, Newbern, D'Angelo, Cassell and Carter were cast in the film.
In August 2024, it was announced that the film is in post-production.
